flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for confirming the Letter of Advice decision or its batch; only the general notice address display (Sebagian).
note: Synonyms tried across the six repos (UI and API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, court batch, batch_no, OIC, route, settled, executed, court letter. Only these were found: labels in translation.json (menu.occurences.letter_of_advice :122, letter_of_advice_list :123, court_batch_no :125, not used by any component), path constants in System.ts (COURT_BATCH_LIMIT :147, COURT_BATCH_DURATION, WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE :163) that no page uses and that have no backend resource, and a UI call to /v1/warrantofarrest (useSearch.ts:69-74) with no controller in any Java repo. The only backend court endpoint is CasIntegrationController (CAS-to-OCMS, not a Letter of Advice feature) and it is not credited: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Story status is blank in the data (requirement not given); traced normally. No maintenance ticket matches (grep letter of advice / warrant / court batch = 0).
recommendation: Evidence 17%. Do not claim a Letter of Advice / batch / OIC routing feature; only UI labels and the general notice view exist.

steps.step: Officer opens the notice and sees the saved defendant address
steps.detail: The notice detail page shows the address (LTA Registered/Mail Address) through isCurrentLetterAddress. This is the general mechanism for Owner/Hirer/Driver, not a screen made for the Letter of Advice decision in the court context; so Sebagian only.

steps.step: Officer confirms the decision to send a Letter of Advice (confirm action)
steps.detail: Only a 'Letter of Advice' label exists in translation.json:122; there is no button, form, hook or endpoint that stores a LOA decision (no hits for letter of advice / LOA / advice in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi). No component references this label.

steps.step: OCMS adds the defendant and notice to the Letter of Advice batch
steps.detail: There is no LOA batch table/entity/service. Court Batch Limit is only a path constant in System.ts:147-150 with no page and no backend resource; OcmsCourtCase only has noticeNo, courtPaymentDueDate, reason. The CAS endpoint is not credited.
